name: Full Witness-Lattice Ample Classes Are Contained in Representation-Map Ample Classes
scope: Finite nonempty ample classes under the signed-coordinate and full ambient complement conventions; hierarchy parameters are held fixed.
statement: Every member of Full Witness-Lattice Ample Classes belongs to Representation-Map Ample Classes.
proof: The full signed lattice always has a degree-one element, obtained by choosing an owner on every cube and applying integral Boolean inversion. An empty witness set would generate only zero.
